completion_notes: Reworked lowering so localise() emits the enriched ElementIR first, then derives the einsum optimizer view from it (now via LocalisationResult.from_element_ir). Added _enrich_element_ir(legacy_ir, problem_ir) helper in fe_localise.py that populates the four P4-1 contract dataclasses from the ProblemIR / ElementIR semantics: GeometrySummary (n_quad, reference_volume from per-element table, natural_coord_dim), MaterialEvalContract (TL→pk2/green_lagrange, UL→cauchy/almansi), LocalForceDescriptor (n_dof = n_nodes*dim), LocalTangentDescriptor (is_symmetric flag from _SYMMETRIC_TANGENT_MODELS = {svk, j2_power_law}). ArtifactBundle.from_pipeline now surfaces the enriched contract blocks in element_ir_summary; pre-P4-3 bundles round-trip cleanly (new keys default to None). 15/15 P4-3 tests pass; full mechdsl-core suite at 1560 pass / 0 fail.
